image_description: A desktop setup featuring a pair of black studio monitor speakers (Logitech brand) flanking an Apple Cinema Display. The left speaker shows a visible woofer and tweeter configuration. A silver keyboard, mouse, and webcam are on the wooden desk. A vase with dried flowers sits behind the left speaker.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visual arrangement matches the standard 2-way monitor design: large woofer at the bottom, small tweeter at the top.
